verdict.rationale: Cactus does route hard queries to the cloud based on local confidence (gh-3), and it documents named platform tiers (Starter, Pro, Custom), a /v1/plans price endpoint and a GET /billing endpoint returning plan limits and period usage. However, the documented pricing and limits concern hosted fine-tuning and data generation, not cloud inference offload. Missing for 10: published prices for cloud inference offload, documented rate limits, explicit usage caps for routed inference, and any independent confirmation of how hybrid-cloud inference is billed.
